extracted.intended_audience: dataset authors, data stewards, data engineers, and developers implementing/validating Datasheets for Datasets (Bridge2AI / D4D users)
extracted.subtask_description: Define, populate, validate, and publish structured datasheets for datasets using the D4D LinkML schema and associated d4d CLI; includes metadata fields, semantic mappings, evaluation workflows, and rendering/validation steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document dataset motivation
rubrics_metrics.description: Datasheets should document the dataset's motivation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the Datasheets for Datasets model: every dataset 'be accompanied with a datasheet that documents its motivation, composition, collection process, recommended uses, and so on'. Include clear statements about why the dataset was created and what problems it is intended to address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document dataset composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Datasheets should describe the dataset's composition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record what the dataset contains (types of records/examples, distributions, classes, sizes). This is one of the core topics in the original Datasheets for Datasets template.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document collection process
rubrics_metrics.description: Datasheets should explain how the data were collected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include procedures, instruments, sampling strategies, preprocessing, and any steps taken during collection that affect data quality or representativeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document recommended uses and limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Datasheets should state recommended uses and any limitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide guidance on appropriate/ inappropriate uses, known biases, failure modes, and constraints on reuse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Answer the topic-specific question set (50+ questions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the Datasheets for Datasets model's topics and question set (the original model contains over 50 questions addressing dataset aspects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Populate the structured questions/topics so that motivation, composition, collection process, recommended uses, provenance, and other topics are explicitly addressed. The repository provides examples and a less-structured markdown template; the LinkML schema represents the topics and expected answer fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use D4D-Core as the recommended entry point
rubrics_metrics.description: Start new datasheets and exchanging systems from the curated, interop-focused D4D-Core schema.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: D4D-Core is the recommended starting point for new datasheets and for systems that exchange datasheets with RO-Crate / FAIRSCAPE / DCAT consumers. Use the core entrypoint (data_sheets_schema_core.yaml).

rubrics_metrics.name: Populate CoreDataset / CoreDatasetCollection / CoreDistribution fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete the core schema classes (CoreDataset, CoreDatasetCollection, CoreDistribution) which together expose ~95 fields in the core.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure required and recommended core slots are filled. The repo lists scope: ~95 fields across these classes; use these for essential interoperability before extending to the full schema.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include structured supporting metadata (Person, Organization, Creator, Grant, FundingMechanism)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supply structured metadata for people, organizations, creators, grants, and funding mechanisms referenced by the dataset.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the supporting classes provided by the schema (Person, Organization, Creator, Grant, FundingMechanism) to standardize provenance and credit information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align slots to external SKOS terms (Semantic Exchange Layer)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pair every D4D-Core slot with a SKOS-aligned external term in the Semantic Exchange Layer for interoperability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Semantic Exchange Layer provides authoritative SKOS alignment (skos:exactMatch / closeMatch / relatedMatch triples) so that a D4D datasheet can round-trip through RO-Crate, FAIRSCAPE EVI, schema.org, DCAT, and Croissant RAI. Use those mappings to ensure semantic interoperability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide SSSOM mappings for semantic exchange
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide semantic SSSOM mappings (including json_path / pydantic / interface columns) to support tooling and round-tripping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The repo contains a 19-column SSSOM mapping and structural SSSOM variants; maintain and regenerate URI/comprehensive/structural variants as needed (scripts available under src/semantic_exchange/).

rubrics_metrics.name: Support RO-Crate round-trip transformation
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow datasheets to be parsed/merged/transformed to and from RO-Crate using the Semantic Exchange Layer and d4d rocrate functionality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use d4d rocrate commands to integrate with RO-Crate metadata and ensure the datasheet can interoperate with RO-Crate/FAIRSCAPE consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validate YAML datasheet against the schema
rubrics_metrics.description: Validate generated datasheet YAML using schema validation (d4d schema validate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the d4d schema inspect/validate commands and the LinkML schema to check that datasheet YAML conforms to D4D-Core or the full schema prior to rendering or exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run presence-based and LLM-based evaluations
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate generated datasheets using presence checks (presence-based) and LLM-based evaluations (d4d evaluate presence / d4d evaluate llm).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presence-based checks assert whether expected fields/sections are present. LLM-based evaluation leverages models (example: --method gpt5) and may require API keys (e.g., ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Use --rubric both to apply multiple rubric sets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support evaluation rubrics (rubric10 / rubric20)
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation outputs conform to rubric variants (rubric10 and rubric20) which are detected or specified when rendering evaluation results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: d4d render evaluation auto-detects rubric10 vs rubric20 unless --rubric is specified. Accept rendering defaults: rubric10 outputs default to *_evaluation.html; rubric20 outputs default to *_evaluation_rubric20.html.

rubrics_metrics.name: Render datasheets and evaluations to HTML (human-readable and LinkML templates)
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce human-readable and LinkML-style HTML renderings of datasheets and evaluation outputs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use d4d render html --template human-readable or --template linkml to render structured input into the respective views. d4d render evaluation renders evaluation JSON and auto-detects rubric variant. Also use d4d render generate-all / make gen-d4d-html for bulk generation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the CLI workflow: download, preprocess, concatenate, evaluate, render, validate
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the d4d CLI workflow groups (download, evaluate, render, rocrate, schema, utils) to create, evaluate, and publish datasheets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Common workflow examples: download/preprocess/concatenate sources for a project; evaluate generated datasheets; render and validate outputs. Commands are shown in README (e.g., poetry run d4d download sources --project AI_READI).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the d4d toolchain and make targets for build/validation
rubrics_metrics.description: Use provided make targets and CLI helpers to generate artifacts, validate core schema, and lint core schema.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make targets include: make validate-core, make gen-core-schema, make lint-core, and make all / make deploy. Use poetry run d4d --help for CLI reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run semantic_exchange and fairscape integration tests
rubrics_metrics.description: Execute provided tests for semantic exchange and FAIRSCAPE integration to ensure mapping correctness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tests live under tests/test_semantic_exchange/ and tests/test_fairscape_integration/; run via pytest (examples: poetry run pytest tests/test_semantic_exchange tests/test_fairscape_integration -v).

rubrics_metrics.name: Be aware of scope: core vs extended schema
rubrics_metrics.description: Know the difference between the curated D4D-Core (~95 fields) and the full schema (~284 attributes) which is an extended reservoir.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use D4D-Core when starting or interoperating; the full schema is available for projects needing extended fields. A merged single-file schema is available (data_sheets_schema_core_all.yaml / data_sheets_schema.yaml).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide curated example datasheets
rubrics_metrics.description: Use curated example datasheets (Bridge2AI generating-center datasheets) as references for content and structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The repository links to curated outputs for AI-READI, CM4AI, VOICE, CHORUS projects; consult these examples to model completed datasheets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain SKOS mapping granularity and variants
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide fine-grained SKOS alignments (100+ skos:exactMatch/closeMatch/relatedMatch triples) and regenerate URI/comprehensive/structural mapping variants as needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generators in src/semantic_exchange/ and mapping artifacts under src/data_sheets_schema/semantic_exchange/ support regeneration of SKOS and SSSOM mappings; keep mappings up to date to preserve interoperability.
